### Gallery

My friend Suyash Prakash (A phenomenal pilot and frankly the only person I trust behind an RC) and I built three RC planes as a hobby: an F-22 Raptor which I called the "Barracuda", a trainer aircraft which was named "Little Wing", and a 3D aerobatic plane which Suyash didn't name :(. Check out his stuff->
